specs.Compatible Devices: Camera, Desktop, Laptop, VoIP Phone, Wireless Access Point

features: 4 PoE Gigabit Ports + 1 Gigabit Uplink + 1 SFP Slot – Provides seamless high-speed data transmission.

Metal Housing with Internal Power Supply – Provides excellent heat dissipation for long-term stable operation.
